ModMetaData.name: Expeditions
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryła
ModMetaData.description:
Go looking for things instead of buying them.
Pick a point of interest on your colony's own map, send a squad as they stand, and they are gone for the trip. What happens out there is rolled off-screen and comes home as a report: what they found, what they could carry, who got hurt, and who did not come back. Sometimes they find nothing.
